hidden_clock: 60 fixed simulation frames per second; wall time measured separately
measurement_notes: Rates use cumulative player-2 counters at simulation seconds 20 and 34, excluding joins; decimal bytes per fixed simulation second, not real-time throughput.
Wall seconds are measured separately; one run per configuration on a shared machine does not establish CPU improvement.
Small-baseline uses preserved protocol-22 session source with the same current optimized CLI/platform and exact game source/assets.
Sight uses actual encoded-cost fallback for patches over 64 KiB; other final variants use the same small-patch path.
Baseline ping/delay/FPS log columns had a temporary printf-format error and are excluded from this artifact; earlier counter columns are valid.
